full_details: Hobbins was in at the Bell with six horses and a pair of thick knitted worsted hose from your mother. You gave him four lines and twopence. You leave on Wednesday the twenty-sixth, by Oxford, and you look to be at the bridge on Friday by dusk. He leaves on Saturday and will be there two days before you. Gilbert said they would have time to sweep, and he sent a paper of pins, not priced as a parcel. Hobbins offered the pack for the sixty shillings. You kept them. The Oxford way is drying in this wind, foul beyond Wycombe, and the river is up at Shipston. Twelve hours to Wycombe at his pace, and nine on the bay. At the Theatre, with the baskets still roped from the Cross Keys, Heminges paid Edith eight shillings out of the stock, five days before Lady Day. You struck the owing line off your tables. Nothing came from your purse. The long letter, the one with no day, is still unsent.
one_sentence: You sent Anne the day you will come, kept sixty shillings in the canvas, and saw Edith paid eight shillings out of the stock.
title: Four lines sent, and eight shillings from the stock
